name: osv-scanner
description: Google's official vulnerability scanner that finds existing vulnerabilities affecting your project's dependencies using the OSV database

osv-scanner.description: Comprehensive vulnerability scanner for open source dependencies with guided remediation and container image scanning
osv-scanner.usage:
osv-scanner --help
osv-scanner --version
osv-scanner scan --lockfile package-lock.json
osv-scanner scan --recursive ./my-project
osv-scanner scan --docker alpine:latest
osv-scanner scan --format json --output results.json ./project
